candidate.declared_product_shape: local-first persistent agent memory backed by SQLite/SQLCipher with semantic, episodic, procedural and working-memory features

source_files_read.purpose: declared architecture/features only; benchmark and product claims remain upstream claims
procedural workflow learning, outcome tracking and prediction
temporal fact assertions, supersession and point-in-time reads
declared intended temporal behavior; tests were inspected, not executed here
graph indexing/coherence and optional projection behavior

source_observations.finding: ProceduralMemory stores named workflows and append-like workflow_runs, then recomputes workflow aggregates from workflow_runs after each tracked outcome.
source_observations.f2_value: Useful donor pattern for derived MethodMemory: retain individual execution evidence and derive success/duration summaries instead of treating a learned method score as primitive truth.

source_observations.finding: predict_outcome uses observed success counts with Laplace smoothing and a sample-count confidence heuristic; trigger lookup is substring matching ordered by historical success_rate/times_run.
source_observations.f2_risk: This is an observational ranking heuristic, not causal proof that a workflow will succeed. Selection effects, context shift and repeated correlated runs can inflate confidence.
source_observations.required_boundary: Expose as METHOD_CANDIDATE / prediction metadata only; never convert it into canonical fact, effect permission or completion authority.

source_observations.finding: Workflow/run identifiers are generated UUID-style IDs; the inspected procedural path does not bind a run to F2 causal_event_id, canonical effect id, generation, source artifact hash or EffectJournal receipt identity.
source_observations.f2_implication: Any donor mechanism must key derived method evidence from existing F2 causal/effect provenance rather than inventing a parallel run identity authority.

source_observations.finding: TemporalKG preserves fact assertions with valid_from/valid_to, supports supersession links, point-in-time queries, timelines and diffs, and keeps closed assertions rather than deleting history.
source_observations.f2_value: The history-preserving assertion pattern is useful for derived temporal views over UnifiedDB evidence, especially when current projection and historical evidence must stay distinguishable.

source_observations.finding: The inspected TemporalKG has a validity interval and created_at, but add_fact sets created_at to the same value as valid_from (including caller-supplied backdated valid_from). No independent transaction-time interval/query was observed in this source path.
source_observations.f2_implication: Treat this source as temporal-validity history, not as demonstrated full bi-temporal semantics. F2 must keep observed/received/transaction identity and world-validity time independently bound if it needs true bitemporality.

source_observations.finding: By default, adding a new object for the same subject+predicate closes all current different objects in the same project.
source_observations.f2_risk: Many predicates are non-functional or unresolved. Automatic replacement can collapse legitimate alternatives into a false single truth.
source_observations.required_boundary: Hyperposition/unresolved alternatives must remain representable; supersession needs predicate policy plus evidence-bearing discriminator, not generic same-(subject,predicate) replacement.

source_observations.finding: The inspected temporal write path accepts source/context/confidence/project fields, but no typed causal-event/admission/generation/artifact/effect provenance envelope is required before an assertion is stored.
source_observations.f2_implication: Do not transplant this fact-write API into canonical state. Typed Entry/UnifiedDB admission must remain upstream authority.

source_observations.finding: ProceduralMemory and TemporalKG write directly through their supplied SQLite connection and the wider project advertises a dedicated SQLite/SQLCipher memory store.
source_observations.f2_implication: Wholesale adoption would risk a second durable truth/memory authority. Reuse only algorithms/schema ideas as derived views/tables inside canonical UnifiedDB or rebuildable projections.

source_observations.finding: The inspected graph store maintains an in-memory index and refreshes it from SQLite using periodic timestamp-based change detection rather than an exact F2 generation/causal-event lease.
source_observations.f2_implication: Do not reuse timestamp polling as authoritative coherence. F2 projections should bind to deterministic generation/source identity and fail closed on stale generation where authority matters.

source_observations.finding: The pinned upstream head includes recent fixes around benchmark access to SQLCipher-backed storage and dependency/version assumptions. These are useful maturity/integration signals, not a product failure proof.
source_observations.f2_implication: Do not grant portability/performance/reliability credit from README claims; any later E3 must reproduce only the narrow mechanism under F2-compatible storage boundaries.

hypothesis.statement: A thin derived procedural/temporal memory layer, implemented over existing UnifiedDB evidence identities, can improve F2 method reuse and historical state reasoning without becoming a second truth authority.
hypothesis.basis: Static donor source shows compact mechanisms for run-derived workflow statistics and history-preserving temporal assertions; both are separable from the donor's standalone database authority.

counterhypotheses.statement: Historical workflow success rates mostly encode context/selection bias and correlated repetitions, so procedural ranking adds little or actively misleads.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Family-split replay comparing causal/context-matched method retrieval against a no-method baseline; duplicated genealogical runs must not count as independent evidence.

counterhypotheses.statement: Existing UnifiedDB/MethodMemory surfaces already contain equivalent run/evidence semantics, making a new adapter redundant complexity.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: E2 map exact F2 tables/APIs against TAM-E1-O1/O4 and identify a concrete missing query or representation before any build handoff.

counterhypotheses.statement: Generic temporal supersession destroys unresolved multi-hypothesis state and therefore conflicts with F2 Hyperposition semantics.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: E2 classify predicates by cardinality/authority and prove alternatives remain representable until an evidence-bearing discriminator closes them.

positive_candidates: append-like method-run evidence with recomputed derived statistics
history-preserving validity views and point-in-time queries
explicit supersession links when a typed predicate policy proves exclusivity
derived method success/duration estimates with visible sample count
hard_rejections: standalone TAM SQLite/SQLCipher as another canonical memory store
workflow success probability as fact/effect/completion authority
freeform provenance fields as a replacement for Typed Entry/UnifiedDB causal identity
timestamp polling as canonical projection coherence
adoption_logic.f2_integration_boundary: If E2 finds a real gap, implement only a thin derived adapter/table/view over existing UnifiedDB identities; EffectGate+EffectJournal and canonical evidence authority remain unchanged.

next_exact_action: Claim R6-SEED-003 E2_ARCHITECTURE_MAPPED create-only, then map TAM-E1-O1/O4 against exact current F2 UnifiedDB/MethodMemory schemas and causal/effect identity paths. Advance only if a non-duplicate representational/query gap is demonstrated; otherwise close as donor-redundant.
